_: A pin held deliberately, with the reason and a date to look again. Not a
way to silence the check: a waiver past its review_by date is reported as
loudly as an unwaived finding, and the reason is printed every week so the
decision stays visible instead of turning into something nobody remembers

waivers.reason: Rocket.Chat 8.8.1 lists MongoDB 8.0 as the only compatible engine, and MongoDB 8.x refuses to start on Linux kernel 6.19 and newer (SERVER-121912, a TCMalloc rseq violation that crashed 8.0+ until MongoDB added the refusal). Verified on 2026-09-09 against kernel 7.0.12: 8.0.28, 8.0.29, 8.0.30 and 8.3.9 all exit at startup; 8.2.12 starts only because it predates the guard, not because it is fixed. GitHub's runners are on kernel 6.17, so CI would pass a bump that a modern host refuses. MongoDB 7.0 is supported until 2027-08-31 and runs everywhere. Held there until an 8.0 patch starts on current kernels.
